About Us

One team, from foundation to final finish

Sri Saravana Enterprises brings civil construction, electrical works and interior design under a single roof. We plan, build and finish every space ourselves — so nothing gets lost between contractors, and every detail is accountable to one team.

Detailed Design

3D visualisation before a single wall is touched.

In-house Execution

Civil, electrical and finishing crews on our payroll.

Quality Materials

Sourced fittings, veneers and fixtures, inspected on site.

On-time Handover

Milestone tracking from kickoff to keys-in-hand.

What We Do

Full-scope design and construction services

Every service below is delivered by our own crews, with one point of contact from concept to completion.

Interior Design

Full-home and single-room design with 3D walkthroughs before execution begins.

Modular Kitchens

L-shaped, U-shaped and island layouts with durable countertops and smart storage.

Wardrobes & Furniture

Custom-built wardrobes, wall units and loose furniture matched to your space.

False Ceiling & Lighting

Layered ceilings and cove lighting designed around how each room is used.

Civil Construction

Structural work, masonry and finishing for new builds and renovations.

Electrical Works

Wiring, panel upgrades and lighting circuits done to safety-certified standards.

Outdoor & Landscape

Pergolas, decks and green walls that extend living space outdoors.

Renovation & Turnkey

End-to-end refurbishment — one schedule, one budget, one handover.
